name: Land of Chivalry
working_title: Valley of Dragons 4: Land of Chivalry
premise: The now-famous Dragon Rider Order is invited by King Charles III to the Kingdom of Bretonnia for a grand jousting tournament. The kingdom is one of the most powerful realms within the wider, politically fragmented Bretonnian Lands. What begins as a ceremonial visit becomes a lesson in chivalry, feudal society, religion, diplomacy and power politics before conspiracy and war turn the visit into a real test of loyalty and courage.
core_themes: political legitimacy and claims to leadership
the difference between ceremonial and practical courage
notes: Land of Chivalry is the accepted working title. No VOD4 prose is accepted as canonical yet. The Google Drive outline and breakdown define current intent; the partial draft is retained only as production evidence because the current writing approach has been rejected for continuation.
